name: Hatto
source:
A duck who lives in Kotori's room at the dorm, he has been there longer than anyone else. Has a love of cucumbers.

[spoiler]He was brought to the dorm by Misagi Isuka, the girl who once lived in Kotori's room.[/spoiler]
